name: AX: Christmas Special
source:
Christmas has arrived in the world of AX! Play the Christmas special accompanied by the waifus from DBZ, explore the protagonist's relationships a year after his arrival in West City, and enjoy six scenes full of angles and poses that will make you want to play it over and over again.

[From [URL=https://creatorx21.itch.io/ax-christmas-special]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
AXE世界的圣诞节已经来临！与DBZ的娃们一起播放圣诞特辑，探索主角抵达西城一年后的人际关系，享受六个充满角度和姿势的场景，让你想一遍又一遍地玩。

[来自 [URL=https://creatorx21.itch.io/ax-christmas-special]itch.io[/URL]]
